enchantment.bubble_cobble.pattern.descri: Blocks are placed in a consistent, grid-like pattern.
enchantment.bubble_cobble.sequence.descr: Blocks are placed in the order they appear in the hotbar.
enchantment.bubble_cobble.soulbound.desc: On death, retains the item and reduces how much durability is lost.
fieldguide.bubble_cobble.research/tuff.d: You gotta say it like you're chewing on a big, scrumptious apple.
fieldguide.bubble_cobble.research/red_dy: They should make a new color that's, like, not bad.
fieldguide.bubble_cobble.research/green_: Sniffer? The Rift? What are you talking about? Come back to your senses, give me all of your Cactus Green and go punch some Sheep.
fieldguide.bubble_cobble.research/gray_d: Ten times the dye wasn't strong enough.
fieldguide.bubble_cobble.research/white_: I cannot make up what it's saying here? Oh no, wait, it's on black ink. We're good.
fieldguide.bubble_cobble.research/bleach: Highly sought-after dye, popped from plants the ancients kept cramming in their mouths. Pppprobably why they all went exinct!
fieldguide.bubble_cobble.research/nether: The Nether be like: "red beans for everyone.". Repulsive, frankly.
fieldguide.bubble_cobble.research/clay_b: I know it makes sense, but why does it take 4 Bricks for... 1 Bricks? You know what I am saying? This roof is gonna take so long, damn it!
fieldguide.bubble_cobble.research/verdan: I've seen a random wiki page claiming that Veridium is "likely named after the Spanish word "verde"". No. Etymology, my baby. It's from the Latin word "viridis"
fieldguide.bubble_cobble.research/scarle: Make from Crimsite, but they're really not *that* "Crimson". A bit unusual, really. In fact, they resemble the saturated clay Bricks from all the way back in Classic.
fieldguide.bubble_cobble.research/asurin: When the people in charge of BLU's side can't be bothered and decide to copy RED's homework. Welcome to CTF Minefort.
fieldguide.bubble_cobble.research/pearl_: So many white bricks it's enough to withstand at least 2 spicy peppers.
fieldguide.bubble_cobble.research/porcel: Ceramic, clay, same thing... No, not really. Not to be confused with Clay, either. This one is fine china.
fieldguide.bubble_cobble.research/towel_: I am not sure how exactly you're capable of compressing flimsy sheets into relatively sturdy matter with your bare hands. I commend you.
fieldguide.bubble_cobble.research/tatami:
Ah, they connect if you place them on the sides. That's neat.
Can I get my straw back?
fieldguide.bubble_cobble.research/hearth:
Sir, a second Tatami Mat has hit the modpack.
They loosely connect, too, if you spin them around.
fieldguide.bubble_cobble.research/flywhe: It's a giant, spinning wheel. Why did you research this? What else do you want to know?
fieldguide.bubble_cobble.research/table_: Where does the Andesite go? Does it hold the whole thing in place?
fieldguide.bubble_cobble.research/indust: It's... Iron? The way it's meant to be. Unlike Minecraft's own idealized standards, this one is meant to look pretty and that's it.
fieldguide.biomeswevegone.oddion.descrip: It looks quite evenion to me. Ordinarion, even.
It is you! The Poi!
(Point of Interest)
fieldguide.create_bic_bit.herring.descri:
Carpe Diem.


   Shoot- that's the wrong one.
fieldguide.minecraft.allay.description: Grouping it among the "animals" is exactly what the Illagers would do. I mean, if you get to know them, they just want to help.
fieldguide.minecraft.bee.description: Last season's hardest worker, really. Comprised 75\% of that world's population. I wonder why? Was it for aesthetics, or to lower the odds of one getting stuck on some leaves?
fieldguide.minecraft.ghast.description: The one thing standing behind you, and your Healing Machine. Go get it.
fieldguide.minecraft.horse.description:
What is the point
I mean, like- You can quite literally ride Scolipede. What more can you ask for?
fieldguide.minecraft.iron_golem.descript: More Iron Ingots. Into the torture chamber you go.
fieldguide.minecraft.polar_bear.descript:
What's goooood? My man-!

    why are you white
fieldguide.minecraft.sheep.white.descrip: Do we really need an entry for each single color? Why, yes. Yes, we do.
fieldguide.minecraft.strider.description: Cute, in a bloody repugnant-sort of way. Much like anyone drinking Aleberry, they too crave the warmth of 300°C bathwater.
fieldguide.minecraft.wither.description: Oh my God is that the Roaring Knight?
fieldguide.minecraft.wolf.description: Not an Arcanine, but it'll do. Unless Lava is involved.
